name: Spear Reit Limited
summary: Spear REIT Limited listed as a Real Estate Investment Trust on the main board of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange. It is the only regionally focused REIT listed on the JSE that invests in high-quality income generating assets in the Western Cape. Spear obtains its diversification through asset type rather than geographical investment. The company conducts its business directly and through a few subsidiaries, collectively referred to as. The group's property and asset management functions are internally and directly managed by the Spear executive management team. Spear Reit Limited was incorporated in South Africa.
